open_risks.text: Five criteria can only be proven on the owner's devices: 16.24 (phone screens read as phone-native, S24 Ultra and Note 10+), 16.35 (Meadow frame timing with three glass layers, reported not bounded), 16.54 (onboarding swipe, scene, roots, stake and tours feel like the prototype), 16.61 (icon on the launcher and in the Dock), 16.62 (glass and petals under Impeller; widget tests render with Skia).

The phone Meadow stacks up to three BackdropFilter blurs (header, dock or pop-over, tab bar) over the animated scene; on the Note 10+ (Impeller on OpenGL ES) this is the costliest case and may drop frames. The owner chose real blur everywhere with cost reported, so a regression shows up only in review on the device.

Wave 2's tasks name interfaces wave 1 creates (GlassSurface and GlassTone in lib/design/glass, PhoneSheet and showPhoneSheet, StreakPill with fixed count, numberOnly and highlighted, the toast lift registration in lib/design/feedback/toast.dart, the onboarding title-top constant). If a wave 1 Lane named or shaped any of these differently, wave 2 Workers will build against names that do not exist; audit wave2.items.json against mitosis/proto-phone-shell before launching.

docs/specs/ is git-ignored and the new prototype under docs/prototype/ is uncommitted, while the tracked docs/prototype/project/ copies are deleted in the owner's working tree. Workers read the spec, decisions, icon and prototype only by absolute path from the main checkout; moving, deleting or committing over those files mid-run takes the reference away.

The approved spec section 17 has 12 assumptions; 1 to 11 were approved at read-back and 12 (Android system back keeps going back one onboarding step) with the written spec. The record and decisions file carry the full set.
At concurrency 2 with a 6-hour Worker timeout, wave 1 (12 Lanes) and wave 2 (8 Lanes, Meadow a 6-Step serial Lane) will each take many hours.

The new rose launcher icon is fully opaque, and reminder notifications use @mipmap/ic_launcher as their Android status-bar icon (lib/features/reminders/local_notifications_reminder_scheduler.dart:21). Android draws a status-bar icon as a white silhouette of its alpha, so reminders will probably show a plain white circle or squircle where the Flutter-logo outline used to be. Not checked on a device. The fix is a separate white-on-transparent peony notification drawable, which is outside the approved spec and needs the owner's call.

Light theme contrast on the new phone calendar: the accentInk terracotta (#c76a54) that the task and prototype name measures 2.98:1 for the 12-point 'This month' pill on paper glass and 3.28:1 for the 13-point 'Back to this month' on cardWarm (Flutter textContrastGuideline at 384x832), below WCAG AA's 4.5:1. Dark theme passes. The sweep has no contrast rule, so no test fails. The owner decides whether to keep the prototype colour or use a darker ink for small text.

open_risks.text: Wave 2 branches were cut from mitosis/proto-phone-shell at 19d9386f, but the shell PR is now at 81d596d9. Commit 81d596d9 changes tour_chapter_test.dart, which wave 2's onboarding-tour also edits, and changes the phone tab bar inks that the tour replica draws. When shell is merged into mitosis/proto-onboarding after wave 2, that file may conflict, and tour tests written against the old inks would fail until updated.

Wave 2 branches were cut from 19d9386f, but main now holds the merged shell at 81d596d9 (strong tab and wordmark inks, tour_chapter_test change) and the app icon. Each wave 2 branch must merge origin/main before its suite and ship. tour_chapter_test, which wave 2's onboarding-tour also edits, may conflict, and wave 2 tests that pin the old tab inks would fail until updated.

Petal draw cost (wave 2 Lane 6, proto-petals-waveform 96e689dd): a lavender petal now takes 22 path draws, so six drifting lavender petals on macOS cost about 130 small path draws per frame. Not measured on a device. Check frame times on the Note 10+ during the owner's device pass (16.62).

Measured on the Note 10+ on 2026-10-03 (Impeller OpenGL ES): the phone Meadow page inside the shell runs at 42 fps (raster p90 25 ms), and at 35 fps with the time pop-over open (29.5 ms). The Meadow bench alone shows the phone-layout glass dock and pop-over dropping to 43-54 fps, against 60 in full screen and 12 of 12 cases at 60 before this work. The owner chose real blur with the cost reported, so whether to step the glass down per device is the owner's call.

Phone Meadow status bar: the clock, signal and battery icons stay dark over the dark glass Meadow header in the light theme, near-invisible at night. app.dart's AnnotatedRegion follows the theme brightness only; BottomBarShell overScene never overrides it.

A fresh macOS install opens at about 873x632 (minimum content height 600). There, the onboarding Mood bloom overlaps the heading: the peony touches 'grows', and the lavender covers the subtitle and 'a day'. At 1140x780 it clears. This is wider than the owner's earlier lavender-at-1140x724 item.
The phone onboarding blocked-swipe toast is see-through glass on a device, so the 'write anything at all to keep going' hint shows through its text. This is worse than the opaque test render.

Phone Meadow speed accepted on the Note 10+ (42 fps in the shell, 35 fps with the pop-over) pending an S24 Ultra run. Use the same device-pass mbench.apk and sbench.apk (built at 9e41b3ba) for an apples-to-apples comparison.

Meadow time-of-day picker and Play the day show for every user; no debug-only controls
The light/dark toggle lives only in onboarding; afterwards theme is changed in Settings only
Voice waveform takes the prototype's fixed bars and playback; the bob goes
Collapsible macOS sidebar that remembers its state; one shared phone sheet; week start as a sheet
Real glass blur on every device, cost reported not bounded; rose icon as an adaptive Android icon and on Apple's grid
Dispatch in two mitosis waves with proto- unit names on a base branch at e36ea842
Land the failed Lane 2 by fixing its two test bugs and flipping it to held
Fix the two existing tests no Step owns in a named fix-up commit after wave 1
Build the 40-point phone composer buttons in the fix-up, and narrow the Tab-reach loosening
